title: Chapter 147: The Approval of the White Cat
html:
“Are you serious? That sounds like a threat.” Liu Dao knew Chen Ge was not joking. They had not known each other long, but he had already learned that the man was… somewhat unusual.

“No, it’s sincere advice. Just pass on exactly what I said.” Chen Ge sounded perfectly calm, privately admiring his own kindness. “At the end of the day, we’re only competitors. Shameless as he is, I don’t want to watch him walk to his death. Besides, his livestream employs a whole crew. Those people are innocent, and he ought to consider their safety.”

Competitors? Death? Innocent lives? Are we even discussing the same thing?Liu Dao wondered which of them was drunk. How was he supposed to tell Qin Guang that copying Chen Ge again would get him killed?

“Chen Ge, I know you’re angry, but please calm down. We can beat him with better content; there’s no need for threats. If anything, this could give them grounds to sue us.” Liu Dao tried to reason with him. Their contract was already signed, and their first official collaboration began tomorrow. The last thing he wanted was for Chen Ge to do something reckless at such a critical moment.

“You wouldn’t understand even if I explained.” Chen Ge walked toward the Haunted House. “If there’s nothing else, I’ll see you tomorrow afternoon.”

“Remember to come early. We still have a lot of details to discuss.”

“Got it.” After hanging up, Chen Ge’s mood sank. The livestream itself meant little to him; Qin Guang and the extra popularity were merely incidental. He cared about only one thing: surviving long enough to uncover the clues his parents had left behind. He glanced toward the canopy of the tree beside the Haunted House, but the white cat was nowhere in sight.

So it finally left.He had grown surprisingly attached to the cat. Odd-colored eyes are rare in a stray, but it has a life of its own. I can’t force it to stay.

The realization saddened him more than he expected. He entered the Haunted House alone, its long corridor lifeless at night. When he switched on the lights, his solitary shadow stretched away before him. The sight was lonely, but loneliness was something he had long since learned to live with.

He washed his face in the bathroom, then headed for the staff break room. Before he went inside, something struck him as odd. Why is the door open?

There were two keys to the break room. He carried one; the other was hidden above the doorframe for the convenience of the Haunted House staff. Only former employees knew where to find it.

If Xu Wan had been here, she would have locked the door before leaving. An outsider must have broken in.Chen Ge detoured to the props room and retrieved Doctor Skull-cracker’s iron hammer.

He eased open the break-room door. The room was dark, with no one in sight.

The spare key is gone. Did the thief take it?Chen Ge swept his gaze across the room. The only thing out of place was an unwashed jacket on the table.

I hung that beside the bed after changing this morning. How did it get onto the table?He switched on the light and used the hammer to lift the jacket.

Beneath the dirty jacket lay the pure-white cat. It raised its head impatiently, resentment shining in its mismatched eyes. Behind it, a grimy rag doll lay across its tail. Xiaoxiao seemed to have been trying to cling to the cat, but Chen Ge’s sudden entrance caught her by surprise. She froze in fright and instinctively played dead.

“Xiaoxiao?” The sight took him aback. I thought these two couldn’t stand each other.

The white cat, my jacket…As Chen Ge studied the jacket, understanding dawned. The night he took the cat to the veterinarian, he had wrapped her and the kittens in it.

The scent of the four kittens must still linger on the fabric. Both the jacket and the basket that carried them are inside the locked break room.

Few people knew about the key above the doorframe, but Xiaoxiao wandered through the Haunted House every day. She must have discovered it long ago. By now, she might even know the building better than Chen Ge did.

Chen Ge lifted Xiaoxiao by one leg and shook her twice. A copper key tumbled from her pocket.

“Are you trying to take over as manager?” Unsure whether to laugh or cry, he placed Xiaoxiao beside the white cat and returned the key above the doorframe. Standing in the cold corridor, he was struck by how bright and warm the break room suddenly seemed.

Xiaoxiao settled beside the cat on the table. The cat ignored her but did not push her away, merely lying there with the unruffled air of a creature beyond anyone’s influence.

A smile touched Chen Ge’s lips. I used to live here alone. Now the place is getting rather lively.

After closing the door, Chen Ge sat down and took out the black phone to review his Daily Missions. His three options were to hire more employees, conduct a safety inspection, or install a sturdy door for the Mu Yang High School scenario.

Every one of these is an urgent problem for the Haunted House. He updated the attraction’s online page to introduce the new scenario and advertise the cash prize, then posted a recruitment notice. It listed only one requirement—the applicant had to be brave.

I need to be selective when hiring. With Uncle Xu still helping at the ticket booth, we can barely manage for now, so recruitment can wait. But as the Haunted House expands, I can’t ignore security. I should choose the safety inspection for today’s Daily Mission.

Chen Ge got to work. He inspected every potential hazard in the Haunted House and drafted new safety rules, yet the black phone gave no indication that he had completed the mission.

What am I missing? I’ve checked every scenario, so why isn’t the mission complete?He stared at the phone. He might have to undertake a Three-Star Trial Mission tomorrow and needed time to prepare. He could not afford to waste the night on a Daily Mission.

Wait. Could it be the mirror in the bathroom?
